description: This file implements a transformation that splits array initializations into separate declaration and assignment nodes within an abstract syntax tree, used in shader code translation.

classes.name: SeparateArrayInitTraverser
classes.description: A private class that traverses the AST to identify array initializations that can be split into separate declaration and assignment nodes.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method that applies the transformation to the AST root node.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Visits declaration nodes to determine if they contain array initializations suitable for splitting.
